name: Tool Receipt
query:
Select 
T.name AS "Document No:Link/TMS Tool Receipt",
T.posting_date AS "Date:Date:100",
T.customer AS "Customer:Link/Customer",
T.customer_name AS "Customer Name",
T.receipt_type AS "Receipt Type",
T.transfer_out_location AS "Transfer Out Location",
T.transfer_reference AS "Transfer Out:Link/Transfer Out",
TI.item_code AS "Item:Link/Item",
TI.item_name AS "Item Name",
TI.physical_tool_code AS "Physical Tool Code",
TI.qty AS "Qty",
TI.rate AS "Rate",
TI.amount AS "Amount"

From `tabTMS Tool Receipt` T
inner join `tabTMS Tool Receipt Item` TI on TI.parent = T.name
Where T.docstatus<2 and T.posting_date between %(from_date)s and %(to_date)s
